citizen_docs.title: Inyandiko zawe
citizen_docs.intro: Ibyo ubusabe bwawe bukeneye n’aho buri kimwe kigeze. Nta na kimwe hano kibuza ubusabe bwawe gukomeza: ikigo kizagenzura ibisigaye aho ikizamini kizabera.
citizen_docs.error: Ntitubashije kubona inyandiko zawe. Ongera ugerageze nyuma y’akanya gato.
citizen_docs.all_done: Ibyo ibigo bibasha kugenzura byose byarangiye.

sat.API_VERIFIED: Cyagenzuwe mu buryo bwikora n’ikigo gishinzwe kubibika
sat.AWAITING_NESA: NESA ntirasohora ibi bisubizo. Tuzongera tugenzure ubwacu; nta cyo usabwa gukora.

type.DEGREE_DIPLOMA_NOTARIZED: Impamyabumenyi y’kaminuza cyangwa dipolome (yemejwe na noteri)

clearance.field_label: Numero y’ubusabe bw’icyemezo cy’uko utigeze uhamwa n’icyaha
clearance.hint: Saba icyo cyemezo kuri IremboGov, hanyuma wandike hano numero y’ubusabe bwacyo: inyuguti imwe, imibare 12 n’inyuguti 4.
clearance.shape: Iyi numero ntabwo iri mu buryo bukwiye: inyuguti imwe, imibare 12 n’inyuguti 4.
clearance.closed: Ubu busabe bwarafunzwe, bityo ntushobora kongeraho numero.

state.NUMBER_REQUIRED: Turacyakeneye numero y’icyemezo cy’uko utigeze uhamwa n’icyaha.
state.VERIFYING: Turimo kugenzura icyemezo cyawe. Bishobora gufata iminota mike; nta cyo usabwa gukora.
state.UNDER_OFFICER_REVIEW: Umukozi azareba icyemezo cyawe. Nta cyo usabwa gukora.

code.CERTIFICATE_NUMBER_MALFORMED: Numero ntiri mu buryo bukwiye. Yisubiremo ugerageze.
code.CERTIFICATE_NOT_FOUND: Ntitwabonye icyemezo gifite iyi numero. Yisubiremo ugerageze.
code.CERTIFICATE_NOT_BOUND: Aya makuru ntahuye n’ayawe. Reba ko wanditse numero y’icyemezo cyawe bwite.
code.CERTIFICATE_WRONG_TYPE: Iki si icyemezo cy’uko utigeze uhamwa n’icyaha. Saba icyemezo gikwiye kuri IremboGov, ushyiremo numero yacyo.
code.CERTIFICATE_EXPIRED: Iki cyemezo cyarashaje cyangwa ntikiratangira kugira agaciro. Saba gishya kuri IremboGov.
code.CERTIFICATE_NOT_VALID: Iki cyemezo nticyemewe ukundi. Saba gishya kuri IremboGov.
code.DEFAULT: Ntitwabashije kwakira iki cyemezo. Reba numero ugerageze.

category_rules.title: Ushobora gusaba, kandi kugeza ku myaka ingahe
category_rules.intro: Buri cyiciro gifite imyaka ntarengwa yacyo, bitewe n’amashuri wize. Shaka icyawe hano hasi.
category_rules.science: Nibura {{percent}}% mu masomo ya siyansi y’amashuri yisumbuye
category_rules.none: Imyaka ntarengwa y’aya mahirwe iri mu itangazo ryemewe.

apply.nida_body: Aya makuru aturuka mu irangamuntu y’igihugu. Ntushobora kuyahindurira hano. Niba hari ikitari cyo, kigomba gukosorwa kuri NIDA.
apply.nida_unavailable: Ntitubashije kukwereka amakuru yawe ya NIDA ubu. Ushobora gukomeza; ubusabe bwawe buzagenzurwa kuri NIDA uko byagenda kose.
